passages.excerpt_preview: Rama and Lakshmana proceeding with Vishvamitra sojourn in a hermitage at a place where  River Ganga and River Sarayu are confluent. Once god Shiva with his third eye burnt down the physical  entity of Manmatha, the Love-god, at this place.
